title: Sauder August Hill L-Desk in Dover Oak, Brown, Desks
text: The Sauder August Hill L-Desk in Dover Oak with slate-finish accents, designed with country style in mind, offers a bevy of essential features such as a file drawer with full extension slides holds letter-size hanging files, a lower shelf for additional storage and grommet holes and pass-throughs for cord management.
